summary: This Form 6-K filing by Collective Mining Ltd. is a press release announcing the discovery of a precious metal-rich oxidized zone at its Apollo target in Colombia. It reports assay results from seven drill holes, with intercepts up to 71.20 meters at 1.95 g/t gold equivalent from surface. The company describes the zone as open for expansion and states it has US$113.3 million cash for a planned 100,000-meter drilling program. There is no mention of any merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. This is a routine operational update on exploration results with no special-situation characteristics.
